payload.summary: Independent review of the final candidate and Tester evidence is complete; the exact declared deterministic command reran with matching exit and normalized stdout hash. Gate 3 remains unexecuted.
findings: The assigned plan, Planner publication, Tester report, deterministic-command record and final candidate hashes match the assignment references. All seven Tester top-level evidence references exist and match their SHA-256 values; the referenced execution, criteria-fidelity, package and integrity records bind to the same archive.

The original plan lists the frozen Charter, Gate 3 v0.2 and C3 erratum as protected sources. The Tester criteria-fidelity record reports exact E1-E10 text equality using C3 for E4; the protected-source hashes match the recorded HEAD values. This is static fidelity evidence only.

Tester execution records report six required suites on source and clean extraction: each root has 126 tests, 125 passed and 1 symlink privilege skip (WinError 1314); all twelve exits are zero. Root-bound examples, stale-hash negative control, Full Plan checksum checks, archive integrity and source-byte mapping are reported with linked records.

The release archive has 115 entries, CRC test returned no bad entry, and independent scan found zero retired-alias path/content hits. The retirement audit records historical text-only exceptions outside active/installable surfaces; the archive excludes the three specified stale delivery/status reports.

The exact Tester-declared executable, arguments, working directory, candidate and three input references were rerun. Exit code and CRLF-to-LF-only normalized stdout SHA-256 match; this establishes repeatability for that command only.

Gate 3 was not executed. The observed evidence does not establish host skill activation, TOML loading, OS isolation, junction/TOCTOU safety, or dynamic unavailable-MCP fallback. The handoff and local checkpoint are not part of this command comparison and remain for Manager/Planner closeout.
